# Included sources - the list a program acts on

**A source that is not on this list is excluded.** Generated by `include_list.py` from `included/`; do not edit. A source is here only when the independent check confirmed it, its terms allow reading for one's own job search (an open licence or the publisher's own statement), a program can read it without anyone's approval, and it is not on the exclude list. Rules: `briefs/INCLUDED-BRIEF.md`.
